description: This source file defines the SameProcessServiceHandle class, a Java class implementing a ServiceHandle for services running within the same JVM, omitting IPC/Events marshaling.

classes.name: SameProcessServiceHandle
classes.description: A ServiceHandle implementation representing a service running in the same JVM, bypassing IPC and event marshaling.

methods.name: SameProcessServiceHandle
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handle with service name, IPC, event identifiers, and optional visibility.

methods.name: getIpcHandler
methods.description: Returns the IPCReceiverHandler associated with the service.

methods.name: setIpcHandler
methods.description: Sets the IPCReceiverHandler for the service.

methods.name: getEventProducer
methods.description: Returns the JavaEventProducer associated with the service.

methods.name: setEventProducer
methods.description: Sets the JavaEventProducer for the service.

methods.name: isSameProcess
methods.description: Indicates that the service runs in the same process (returns true).

methods.name: isLocalHost
methods.description: Indicates that the service runs on the local host (returns true).

methods.name: isRemoteHost
methods.description: Indicates whether the service is on a remote host (returns false).
